verdicts.reason: A stacks the headline at a huge size and blows the CTA up to almost the same size, so the two compete for attention. The CTA also wraps badly ('Line' sits alone), the SOLSTICE logo shrinks to an illegible speck and the text fills the canvas edge to edge. B stays faithful with a centred logo, headline and CTA in the right order, but it doesn't really rearrange for the tall format: the cluster sits in the middle with big empty bands above and below, the headline nearly touches the side edges, and the logo is small.
